newsitem.title: CHINA: Suez Lyonnaise to open Beijing office.
newsitem.headline: Suez Lyonnaise to open Beijing office.

text.p: Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux will open a representative office in China's capital, Beijing, at the end of this year or in early 1998, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The French conglomerate was planning massive investment in China, the newspaper said without giving further details.

The company was discussing the possibility of a long-term partnership with China International Trade and Investment Corp (CITIC) and formal talks between the two firms were scheduled for September, it quoted Chairman Jerome Monod as saying.
Monod said he saw huge business opportunities in China as the government invested heavily in sewage treatment, waste disposal and hydroelectric power development.

The company, already contracted to build the Ertan power plant dam in southwestern Sichuan province, signed a contract with Bijie Public Utilities Co on July 22 to build a drinking water plant in southern Guizhou province, the newspaper said.
